tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and frame ground. Aged paper in Paper, lamp-lit walnut in Lamplight. About 60% of any frame.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Cartouche plates, lower-third bodies and the fill inside the logo medallion.

tokens.name: ground-sunk
tokens.usage: The sea behind engraved maps, wells and map margins.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, titles, coastline strokes and logo outlines.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, source lines and secondary labels. 4.5:1 on ground in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rules, graticule lines, cartouche inner border and land hatching. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: madder
tokens.usage: The red for text: kickers, the year, link colour and hatch lines over the territory.

tokens.name: territory
tokens.usage: Fill for the one territory a video is about. About 10% of a frame, always outlined in ink.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: North tick and gilded ornament. Graphics and large text only in Paper (3.5:1).

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: Second state on a map and water labels, the colour of aged copper.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Sea fill, ruled with sepia wave lines in Paper and plain in Lamplight.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Land fill on every map.

tokens.name: map-hatch
tokens.usage: Engraved hatching across land, at 30° and 0.8px.

tokens.name: map-border
tokens.usage: Coastlines and border strokes, 2px at 1080p.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on web surfaces.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Chapter-card titles and the cover name.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Channel description and long-form web text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A border is an agreement someone can break.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Date and place stamps above titles, in small capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Rule spacing inside double rules.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks such as kicker to title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Small plate padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Plate padding and section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Frame margins and cover band module.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large frame margins.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Cover colour-band module.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Plates, cartouches, maps and thumbnails: square like a printed sheet.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Web chips.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Web tags only; the logo medallion is the one round form.
